verdict.rationale: An in-product AI assistant that surfaces insights from your data is a reasonable thing to ask of a database/backend platform, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions. The 'insights' items (`npx convex insights`, the Health & insights dashboard) are deployment-health features, not AI analysis of user data. Vector search is a developer building block for building AI apps, and the MCP server lets external agents access the deployment rather than delivering AI insights inside Convex itself.
